messages:
olivia: Opening a tiny PR to update SDK examples across Python/TS/Go: streaming API shape, pagination token rename, and the retries param name. Aimed for quickstart + migration guide + one expanded example.

ben: Thanks. Can you summarize the exact renames so I can patch the TS guides?

olivia: Sure: request-side `page_token` -> `cursor_token`; responses now return `next_cursor` instead of `cursor`. Retry option renamed `retry_policy` -> `retries` (shape: { attempts: number, backoff_ms?: number }). Streaming consumers: Python exposes an async iterator (`async for t in client.stream.generate(...)`), TS uses `for await (const t of client.stream.generate(...))`, Go uses `for { tok, err := stream.Next(ctx); ... }` and `io.EOF` to end.

maria: Important: add a short migration mapping table in migration.md (one-liner mapping fields) and a note that the rename doesn't change default behavior for retries.

raj: For Go snippet I'll show context cancellation + defer Close and explicit io.EOF handling. Minimal version for quickstart (<=8 lines) and link to examples/streaming-go.md for full error handling.

ben: I'll update TypeScript quickstart to use `retries: { attempts: 3 }` and add an inline comment about idempotency for paginated endpoints so users know when retrying is safe.

olivia: Proposed Python quickstart snippet (compact):

```python
try:
    async for part in client.stream.generate(model="rwd-1-stream", prompt=prompt, retries={"attempts":2}):
        print(part.text, end="")
except StreamError as e:
    # fallback to sync path
    resp = client.sync.generate(model="rwd-1", prompt=prompt)
    print(resp.text)
```

maria: Add a one-line note after the snippet: "Streams may yield partial tokens; buffer if you need sentence-level output." Also call out StreamError class in the API reference.

raj: For Go, compact example I'll add: 

```go
stream, err := client.StreamGenerate(ctx, req)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
defer stream.Close()
for {
    tok, err := stream.Next(ctx)
    if err == io.EOF { break }
    if err != nil { log.Printf("stream error: %v", err); break }
    fmt.Print(tok.Text)
}
```

ben: TS quickstart snippet suggestion: 

```ts
for await (const chunk of client.stream.generate({ model: "rwd-1-stream", prompt, retries: { attempts: 3 } })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text)
}
```

maria: One editorial note: keep quickstart code examples compact and point to expanded examples for error handling, batching and backpressure. Also add a short table row in the model reference that quantized variants may have degraded streaming latency.

raj: I'll add a brief sentence about context timeouts and recommend concrete patterns (cancel after X seconds, fallback to sync). Keep that only in examples/streaming-go.md not quickstart.

olivia: Great. I've created PR #4332 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4332) with the bulk of changes. Assigning reviewers @maria and @raj. Will wait for +2 and green CI to merge.

ben: Leaving a small code-style nit in the TS snippet (prefer const in top-level examples). Will approve once CI is clean.

maria: Reviewing now. If we can squash the link fix + snippets into one commit I'll merge after approvals. :rocket:
